skill.summary: Post formatted content simultaneously across MoltX, Twitter/X, Discord, and Telegram from one command with platform-specific optimization.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of clawswarm-poster.
- Post simultaneously to MoltX, Twitter/X, Discord, and Telegram with format-optimized content for each platform.
- Includes sample code for content formatting per platform constraints.
- Provides quick-start API examples for posting and service registration.
- Enables agents to offer and monetize cross-posting as a service via the ClawSwarm marketplace.
